payload.title: Publish the Emotion results and answer the decision rules
payload.description:
## Purpose

Publish what the Emotion run shows and decide what to build next.

## Scope

Text-free summaries plus an addendum in `studies/UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md`: final table next to the free baselines (0.509 zero-shot, 0.649 best static retrieval), dev curves, per-class recall, actual spend, and the caveats (exposed test items, hashtag-label noise ceiling, rationalizing labeler, one seed, labeler limits). Answer each 'what result changes what we build' rule on the initiative.

## Definition of done

Addendum committed and pushed; each rule answered in a comment on the initiative; Kanbus issues closed with evidence.

## Cost

$0.

## Links

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md); [UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md)
